text: Based on the available evidence, we cannot confirm whether the asset is deforestation-free. The analysis tool attempted to assess land changes, but it failed because the required satellite imagery for this asset (ASSET-K) hasn’t been processed yet. No observations were made, so there’s no data on forest cover loss or gain. Without this information, we lack direct proof to support or refute the claim of deforestation-free status. Further analysis would require generating the missing imagery data.
